English internal edition · 25 September 2026. These instructions and screenshots were checked against the current source and a local release build with synthetic accounts. Live camera and assessment recovery, institution support details, and first-time reader testing require further review before public distribution.

Choose the guide for your role:

  • Student guide — join a class, take or recover a quiz, see results, and create personal practice quizzes.
  • Lecturer guide — create classes and quizzes, publish, review attempts, release results, and export reports.
  • During a quiz: quick help — fast recovery steps when a student is paused or cannot submit.
  • Troubleshooting — find a symptom and its next step.
  • Terms used in this manual — meanings of assessment, reveal, attempt, and other labels.
  • Get more help — what to report and who can resolve it.

Student quick start

  1. Create your account or sign in.
  2. Join your lecturer's class.
  3. Find a class quiz.
  4. If the assessment requires it, set up your face and follow the start instructions.
  5. Answer and submit.
  6. Check your result once it is available.

Lecturer quick start

  1. Create your lecturer account or sign in.
  2. Create a class and share its join code.
  3. Create a quiz and add questions.
  4. Check and publish the quiz.
  5. Monitor attempts and release results.

Using the manual on a phone

Easy2U uses top navigation on a desktop and a bottom dock on a phone. Some lecturer tools use sheets or compact lists on a phone. The guides label steps Desktop and Phone wherever the action changes. Close the on-screen keyboard if the bottom dock is temporarily hidden.

Before you start

Use the account and class details supplied by your institution or lecturer. Assessments that require face verification need a working camera, camera permission, and a well-lit space. Some options, including Microsoft sign-in, AI question generation, web topic search, and hand gestures, appear only when your institution or lecturer enables them.

This searchable website is the primary manual. Download the English internal PDF for printing or offline use. It is generated from the same content. See the change log for the app version and capture date.
